chunks.name: 📄️fixture-readers
chunks.doc: 📄️ Transaction law fixture readers: the fixture text and its JSON accessors, the clock and reference decoding, the yield decoding and the transaction constructor.

chunks.name: 🧮️reducer-and-id-laws
chunks.doc: 🧮️ Reducer and id laws: the state, yield and refusal kinds, the reducer matrix and cases, the resume order and the LEB128 and blake3 oracle of the minted ids.

chunks.name: 🌊️gesture-tool-laws
chunks.doc: 🌊️ Gesture tool laws: the example drag gesture statecharts, the gesture runner and its replay of every fixture scenario, the resume rows and the press, drag and release transaction.

chunks.name: 🏃️runner-laws
chunks.doc: 🏃️ Runner laws: the probe statecharts, the refused and unpublished yields and the timer, abort and rest behaviour of the runner.

chunks.name: 🫧️scrub-laws
chunks.doc: 🫧️ Scrub laws: the scrub tool tables, chart and phases against the fixture, the ledger replay, the persisted scrubs and the late inputs.

chunks.name: ⌨️typing-laws
chunks.doc: ⌨️ Typing laws: the typing tool tables, chart and phases against the fixture, the algebra folds, the ledger replay and the persisted run.

chunks.name: 🕸️node-drag-and-once-laws
chunks.doc: 🕸️ Node drag and once laws: the node drag rows and their commit as one transaction, the one-step tool and the independent dispatches.
